description: The reader's check is skipped: an add saves a URL, header or variable the reader then skips
The check forgets that the profile skips an Authorization header
Only add reads the profile's keys: remove rewrites a profile whose servers key is misspelled
The write comes before the check: a refused add has already changed the file
old:
THEN /\ UNCHANGED <<st, ent, added, wroteTypo>>
            /\ last' = "refused"
            /\ same' = TRUE
new:
THEN /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![f] = "ok"]
            /\ ent' = [ent EXCEPT ![f][n] = c]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<added, wroteTypo>>
            /\ last' = "refused"
            /\ same' = FALSE

description: An edit uses the scan fx runs at load, which gives up on a big file
A remove takes out every entry of the removed entry's class
new: ELSE /\ ent' = [ent EXCEPT ![f] = [m \in Names |-> IF ent[f][m] = ent[f][n] THEN NoEntry ELSE ent[f][m]]]

description: A remove of a name that only the misspelled key holds gives no hint: it says only that no server has the name
old: THEN /\ last' = IF HintFor(f, n) THEN "hinted" ELSE "missing"

description: A remove gives the hint for every name it can't find, whether or not the misspelled key holds it
old: THEN /\ last' = IF HintFor(f, n) THEN "hinted" ELSE "missing"

description: A remove of a name that only the misspelled key holds takes it out of that key and writes the profile
old:
THEN /\ last' = IF HintFor(f, n) THEN "hinted" ELSE "missing"
            /\ heldHit' = HintFor(f, n)
            /\ same' = TRUE
            /\ others' = TRUE
            /\ UNCHANGED <<st, ent, added, wroteTypo>>
new:
THEN /\ last' = IF HintFor(f, n) THEN "removed" ELSE "missing"
            /\ heldHit' = FALSE
            /\ same' = ~HintFor(f, n)
            /\ others' = TRUE
            /\ wroteTypo' = (wroteTypo \/ HintFor(f, n))
            /\ UNCHANGED <<st, ent, added>>
